name: 俄罗斯
fact: A 51-km D-type Trojan in Jupiter's leading L4 swarm. D-type asteroids are believed to be among the most primitive bodies in the solar system, with surface composition that preserves chemistry from the outer protoplanetary disc largely unchanged for 4.5 billion years.
bio: Discovered 1999, named for Orus — a Trojan ally killed by Ajax in the Iliad. Lucy's 2028-11-11 encounter will measure surface composition, regolith properties, and any satellite presence, completing the survey of the leading-cloud spectral range (C → P → D).
